mapper.sql:
FROM bike_sales_order o JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=i.product_model_id WHERE o.customer_id=#{customerId} AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PARTIAL_SHIPPED') AND i.ordered_qty>i.shipped_qty
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR m.model_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
mapper.select:
SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.customer_id,m.model_name,i.ordered_qty order_qty,i.shipped_qty,o.status
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
